messages:
anna: FYI, the streaming generator sample app is hanging when the auth token refresh happens mid-stream. Repro steps below.

mike: repro for me too. saw it on mac, go1.20, go-sdk v0.12.3

anna: minimal repro:
```go
ctx := context.Background()
g := sdk.NewGenerator(cfg)
stream, _ := g.Generate(ctx, req)
// wait for refresh to kick in
_, err := stream.Recv()
// hang here
```

jen: logs? any panic or stuck goroutine?

anna: no panic. goroutine stack shows blocked in recv loop waiting on chan with no signals. token refresh callback returns new token but not injected into active stream.

rahul: this rings a bell — we don't propagate new auth into mid-flight generator connections. Onboarding sample uses implicit auth refresh which only affects new connections.

sam: workaround: pre-warm token or call `client.SetAuthToken(newTok)` and reconnect stream. Ugly.

devx-bot: linked issue #421: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/issues/421

mike: can we update the sample to show explicit token-forwarding pattern and also log guidance in README? PR incoming.

anna: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/1234 — adds pattern and small fix to generator handshake to accept token update messages.

jen: QA note: add e2e test that simulates refresh during stream and ensure generator resumes or returns error cleanly.

rahul: agree. also need clear guidance in onboarding quickstart: "avoid implicit auth refresh mid-stream".

sam: cc @security — any concerns with exposing token rotation pattern in sample app?

security: fine as long as examples use short-lived dev tokens and call out KMS/HSM recommendations.

anna: resolution plan: ship sample change + runtime fix in v0.13.0, add docs and e2e. Assigning to @mike + @jen. :thumbsup:

mike: working on tests now, will update PR later today.

anna: thanks all, will follow up on the release checklist.
